name: McLaren P1™
description: Ignite your love for supercars with this breathtaking 1:8 scale LEGO Technic McLaren P1 hypercar. With 3,893 pieces, this Ultimate-level build features an authentic V8 engine with moving pistons, dihedral doors that open just like the real car, functional steering and suspension, and a rear wing spoiler. A true engineering masterpiece for adult builders who demand the most complex and rewarding building experience.
